parts.style: calm, reverent, reading scripture aloud slowly
parts.text: Let your conversation be without covetousness; <short pause> and be content with such things as ye have: <short pause> for he hath said, I will never leave thee, nor forsake thee. <short pause> Hebrews, chapter thirteen, verse five.

Lord, You have promised never to leave me or forsake me. <short pause> That promise is enough. <short pause> Help me be content with what I have tonight, knowing Your presence is my greatest treasure. <short pause> I rest in the certainty that You are always with me. <short pause> Amen.
